problem.explanation: This query creates a derived value with arithmetic: 2026 - birth_year. The alias makes the output meaningful and the ordering readable. A common mistake is reversing the subtraction. Real birth dates need date-aware logic, but the integer-year model is intentional here.
hints: Age here is the target year minus birth_year.
Alias the calculated expression as age so it can be used in ORDER BY.
problem.reference_solution: SELECT name, (2026 - birth_year) AS age FROM members ORDER BY age DESC
problem.statement_markdown: For every member, return name and age in 2026 using birth_year. Show oldest members first.
problem.title: Calculate age in years
